title: My morning
instructions: Hana sabah rutinini anlatıyor. Saatlere ve sıraya dikkat et.

script.speaker: hana
script.text: I get up at seven o'clock every day.

script.speaker: hana
script.text: Then I have breakfast with my brother. I eat eggs and bread, and I drink milk.

script.speaker: hana
script.text: At eight o'clock, I take the bus to school.

questions.prompt: What time does Hana get up?
questions.feedback: Saat yedide (at seven) kalkıyor. Sekiz, otobüs saati.
questions.evidence: I get up at seven o'clock every day.

questions.prompt: What does Hana drink at breakfast?
How does Hana go to school?
questions.feedback: Saat sekizde otobüsle (take the bus) okula gidiyor.
questions.evidence: I take the bus to school.
